ranked.headline: Computational reconstruction of tissue gene expression from single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial atlases now span more species, modalities and histology, demanding methods that correct each measurement's limits.

ranked.headline: Context-aware models infer tumor gene expression, mutations and regulatory networks
ranked.summary: Noninvasive and single-cell measurements are now paired with models encoding chromatin, cell-state, and mutational context.

ranked.headline: Learned models link sequence, contact, and epigenomic features to gene regulation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show longer input sequences can hurt expression prediction, shifting attention to integrating proximal multimodal epigenomic data.

ranked.headline: Knowledge graphs and deep models predict drug-target and drug-indication links
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend biomedical knowledge graphs with single-cell expression, literature-mined target-disease links, and agentic discovery workflows.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and Bayesian models for microbiome and multi-omics inference
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous, small-sample, and simulated omics data demand inference methods that handle batch effects, missing data, and phylogenetic structure.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models tie interaction structure and perturbations to population outcomes
ranked.summary: Stochastic toolkits and higher-order interaction models now make population outcomes testable against explicit mechanistic parameters and perturbation data.

ranked.headline: Reference-free pipelines recover sequences from complex and mixed natural samples
ranked.summary: Long-read and targeted sequencing workflows are being redesigned to recover sequence from HIV amplicon populations, plant DNA mixtures and rDNA arrays.

ranked.headline: Reference and experimental data constrain and validate structural models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication couple cryo-EM maps, MD reference data and AI predictions to model refinement and assessment.

ranked.headline: Limits of protein models for variant effects, conformations and backbone geometry
ranked.summary: Recent work tests where AlphaFold3, ensemble and zero-shot predictions hold against experimental data, as generative models gain control.

ranked.headline: Generative diffusion and autoencoder models are applied to single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend diffusion, autoencoder and multimodal fusion methods to single-cell perturbation, spatial and multi-omic data.

ranked.headline: STR variation and haplotype-resolved assemblies refine population structure inference
ranked.summary: Dense variation beyond SNP panels, from STRs to donor-specific and pangenome assemblies, is now extending population and variant-level inference.

ranked.headline: Sequence foundation models applied to DNA context, splicing, and RNA-seq tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark and extend learned sequence models for splicing prediction, genome annotation, and transcriptomic classification.

ranked.headline: Per-event quantification of single molecules across microscopy and nanopore readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair single-molecule measurements with reliability-aware computational pipelines to extract molecular states from noisy data.

ranked.headline: Pangenomes and long-read assemblies link structural variants to crop traits
ranked.summary: Long-read assemblies now enable pangenome-scale linking of structural variants to fruit color and disease resistance in crops.

ranked.headline: Simulation and structure-aware learning for immune receptor and pathogen sequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair within-host virus simulation and TCR-pMHC graph learning with HLA and structure-based constraints.

ranked.headline: Single-cell transformer attention tracks co-expression rather than regulatory content
ranked.summary: Interpretability and representation analyses of scGPT and Geneformer test what learned single-cell embeddings actually encode beyond co-expression.

ranked.headline: Methods profiling DNA methylation, chromatin and radiation-induced genomic instability
ranked.summary: Long-read, single-cell and large-cohort CpG analyses now resolve methylation dynamics and irradiation-induced genome damage across cell types.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict molecular binding and activity from sequence and graph inputs
ranked.summary: Recent work applies learned interaction predictors to oligonucleotide efficacy, transporter substrates, peptide activity and multi-target bioactivity.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict enzyme function, RNA structure, and natural product biosynthesis
ranked.summary: Recent reports describe sequence models that generalize to unseen enzyme labels, model RNA structure from probing data, and tokenize functional domains.

ranked.headline: Reproducible benchmarking of genomic, chemical, and single-cell AI models
ranked.summary: Standardized benchmarks now target genomic foundation models, reaction property predictors, and LLM agents for single-cell omics analysis.

ranked.headline: Protein language models guide antimicrobial and bioactive peptide design
ranked.summary: Protein language model and generative frameworks are now applied to antimicrobial and bioactive peptide prediction, generation, and screening tasks.

ranked.headline: MD simulations link binding and subdomain structure to membrane and pore transport
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply coarse-grained MD and simulated AFM to membrane, pore, and capsid mechanics at molecular resolution.

ranked.headline: Faster alignment and k-mer placement tools for sequencing reads and phylogenies
ranked.summary: Recent tools target database-scale throughput for read comparison, phylogenetic placement, and selection analysis using parallel and heuristic methods.

ranked.headline: Tractable physics-based and generative prediction of protein-ligand binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published GPU platform target practical binding free energy, virtual screening, and synthesizable generative design.

ranked.headline: Sequencing and computational methods map tRNA structure, modifications and RBP binding
ranked.summary: Single-read and large-scale sequencing methods now map tRNA structure, modification sites, RBP-RNA binding and PIWI cleavage at transcriptome scale.

ranked.headline: Nonsense constraint and deletion predictors refine gene-level variant prioritization
ranked.summary: Large-scale constraint metrics and deletion-aware predictors address gaps in interpreting non-canonical and gene-level coding variation.

ranked.headline: Mechanical models link cell forces, junctions, and nuclear mechanics to tissue behavior
ranked.summary: Mechanically explicit models now link junction tension, nuclear mechanics, and epithelial forces to tissue organization and cell states.

ranked.headline: Computational recovery of peptide and glycopeptide IDs from existing MS data
ranked.summary: Repository-scale top-down spectra and prior-identification-guided search are extending identifications from existing mass spectrometry datasets.

ranked.headline: Reusable tools span regulatory modelling, platform conversion and biomarker analysis
ranked.summary: Recent releases make specialised regulatory, expression, and biomarker analyses accessible through web and standalone interfaces.

ranked.headline: Recovering neural dynamics and synaptic structure from network activity models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address how noisy hippocampal replay, coarse-tuned decoding, and spike-based synaptic inference constrain dynamics recovery.

ranked.headline: Neural models link genotypes and imaging to heritable loci and shared genetic liability
ranked.summary: Population-scale GWAS and multimodal imaging data are now being modeled with interpretable and contrastive architectures for locus and liability discovery.

ranked.headline: Criticality, attractor dynamics and decoding probe large-scale brain dynamics
ranked.summary: Dynamical and decoding descriptors now span human MEG, rodent EEG and mouse fMRI, moving beyond static pairwise correlation.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based models resolve SARS-CoV-2 variant evolution and abundance
ranked.summary: Wastewater sequencing and alignment-free learning now extract variant-level structure from mixed or large viral genomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Quantifying spatial dependence in disease spread, immune niches and grapevine genetics
ranked.summary: Spatial and network-structured dependence is being quantified across pathogen spread, tissue co-occurrence and crop genetic structure.

ranked.headline: Scored homology and structure frameworks map protein motifs, complexes and secretomes
ranked.summary: Preprints now extend scored homology, targeting and phylogenetic frameworks to motif-domain, mitochondrial, complex and secretome analyses.

ranked.headline: Omics and flux models prioritize liver disease genes and dasatinib resistance targets
ranked.summary: Tissue-scale metabolic models and multi-omic causal inference are now applied to liver disease and cancer drug-resistance mechanisms.

ranked.headline: New methods map 3D chromatin organization, enhancer condensates and chromosome mixing
ranked.summary: Recent tools quantify 3D chromatin distances, enhancer communities and chromosome territory formation from imaging and single-cell Hi-C data.

ranked.headline: Single-cell profiling resolves tumor, cortical and atopic skin cell identities
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases now resolve patient-specific malignant states, regional regulatory programs and immune-stromal communities across tissues.
